actions.label: Use marsh cant
actions.text: You speak low marsh cant. The eel-seller nods.

actions.label: Show city papers
actions.text: You show city papers. A watch pair eases back.

actions.label: Call the watch
actions.text: You call the watch. They drag a cutpurse off the stalls.

actions.label: Slip behind the stall
actions.text: You slide into the stall gap. You hear talk of a warehouse chest.

actions.label: Threaten the seller
actions.text: You crowd the board. He talks fast about a tablet in the warehouse.

actions.label: Buy smoked eels
actions.text: You buy smoked eels. Salt stings your lips.

actions.label: Ask about the tablet
actions.text: He says the old compact tablet sits in the warehouse chest.

actions.label: Slip inside the warehouse
actions.text: You slip the side latch. The warehouse takes you in.

actions.label: Force the warehouse door
actions.text: You force the bar. The door jumps. A watch horn sounds far off.

actions.label: Show seal at the warehouse
actions.text: You show the city seal. The ware-hand opens the door.

actions.label: Give tablet to the boss
actions.text: You set the tablet on his crate. He reads and lets out a breath.

actions.label: Sign the dock compact
actions.text: You sign. The crew repeat the compact in one voice.

actions.label: Ask the boss for work
actions.text: He says the compact tablet is gone. Find it and the dock will hold.

actions.label: Report the cutpurse
actions.text: The sergeant logs the arrest. She says the stacks will hear of it.

actions.label: Ask the watch about the tablet
actions.text: She says the tablet is in the warehouse. Papers will open the door.

actions.label: Buy stew
actions.text: You eat hot stew. Your hands steady.

actions.label: Rent a cot
actions.text: You lie down. The room ticks and you rise clearer.

actions.label: Hear gossip
actions.text: A climber says the wind bridge needs a crawl, not a dash.

actions.label: Wade the mudflat
actions.text: You wade the low mud. A brass key sits in a drowned boot.

actions.label: Sort the heap
actions.text: You sort tags by metal. A brass key hides under a plate.

actions.label: Open the side chest
actions.text: The brass key turns. Extra rope sits in the chest.

actions.label: Help the runner
actions.text: You bind her knee. She says Mira at the stacks will mark you kind.

actions.label: Rob the runner
actions.text: You take her coil. She swears the stacks will hear.

actions.label: Climb the switchback
actions.text: You take the outer path. The first ledge holds.

actions.label: Force a climb
actions.text: You haul on stone and rope. The wall gives you a hold.

actions.label: Ask Mira for a tip
actions.text: Mira says crawl the wind bridge. Dashing drops fools.

actions.label: Share marsh path with Mira
actions.text: You share the marsh path. Mira marks a hidden flue.

actions.label: Climb to the mid ledge
actions.text: You work up the inner stair. The mid ledge opens.

actions.label: Rest on the ledge
actions.text: You sit out of the wind. Your breath comes back.

actions.label: Climb to the wind bridge
actions.text: You take the last stair. Planks wait over the gap.

actions.label: Crawl across the bridge
actions.text: You crawl the planks. The relic room is close.

actions.label: Dash across the bridge
actions.text: You dash. The planks hold for your light step.

actions.label: Brace the planks
actions.text: You brace the worst plank and cross slow.

actions.label: Cut the guyline
actions.text: You cut the guyline. The span sags toward the undercroft.

actions.label: Drop to the undercroft
actions.text: You drop into the vault. Beams groan above.

actions.label: Squeeze up to the relic
actions.text: You squeeze a cracked flue. The relic room opens above.

actions.label: Shore the beam
actions.text: You shore the beam. The vault stops its grind.

actions.label: Copy the inscription
actions.text: You copy the bowl script. The lines name the compact as a later law.

actions.label: Leave an offering
actions.text: You leave a strip of cloth. The bowl stays still.

actions.label: Offer reed grain
actions.text: You offer reed grain. Brann marks your name kind.

actions.label: Read the debt ledger
actions.text: You read the board. The mill holds the valley grain as debt.

actions.label: Show city papers
actions.text: You show city papers. Sila's cousin at the board goes still.

actions.label: Cite the dock compact
actions.text: You cite the dock compact. Brann drops the extra grain tax.

actions.label: Swear the mill oath
actions.text: You swear on the board. Brann takes the oath as bond.

actions.label: Pay with a grain sack
actions.text: You set a sack on the board. Brann cuts your name from debt.

actions.label: Kindle the kiln
actions.text: You kindle the kiln. Heat crawls up the brick.

actions.label: Stoke the kiln
actions.text: You stoke until the kiln runs white.

actions.label: Damp the kiln
actions.text: You damp the mouth. The white heat falls back.

actions.label: Set the damper
actions.text: You set the damper. Pell nods at the even draw.

actions.label: Ask Pell about heat
actions.text: Pell says fire the pact only when the mouth runs white.

actions.label: Fire the grain pact
actions.text: You press the debt strip into the kiln. Brann names the pact sealed.

actions.label: Force the sluice stone
actions.text: You force the stone true. The wheel runs even.

actions.label: Ask Sila about debt
actions.text: Sila says the kiln pact is the only clean write-off.

actions.label: Speak reed custom
actions.text: You speak reed custom. Orin grants you standing.

actions.label: Cite city law
actions.text: You cite city law. Orin grants you standing.

actions.label: Name the mill pact
actions.text: You name the mill pact. Orin takes it as clean proof.

actions.label: Hear Tam as witness
actions.text: Tam names the grain theft. He saw the cut at dusk.

actions.label: Swear true witness
actions.text: You swear Tam spoke true. Orin records the oath.

actions.label: Read the reed charter
actions.text: You read the charter. Sentence needs a heard witness.

actions.label: Pass the reed sentence
actions.text: You pass sentence. Orin strikes the mat once.

actions.label: Ask Kesh the rule
actions.text: Kesh says standing first, then a witness, then a sentence.

actions.label: Ask Nia for a roll
actions.text: Nia says the charter is short. Witness, then sentence.

actions.label: Track drowned prints
actions.text: You track wet prints to the beacon path. Cal nods.

actions.label: Force the hut latch
actions.text: You force the latch. Cal lets you take the lamp oil.

actions.label: Name the reed sentence
actions.text: You name the reed sentence. Cal grants the road as owed.

actions.label: Walk the flood berm
actions.text: Rain lifts the berm path. You mark a dry line to the beacon.

actions.label: Follow the fog bell
actions.text: You follow the bell through fog. The beacon post shows.

actions.label: Ask Rell the weather
actions.text: Rell says rain opens the berm. Fog hides the bell path.

actions.label: Light the road beacon
actions.text: You light the pan. The drowned road holds a line of fire.

actions.label: Wade the drownway
actions.text: You wade the rain cut. Poles lead you true.

actions.label: Cut reed herb
actions.text: You cut reed herb. Joss lets you pass the still.

actions.label: Read the isolation order
actions.text: You read the isolation order. It names the still recipe.

actions.label: Hail the clean boat
actions.text: You hail a clean boat. Cloth and oil come ashore.

actions.label: Brew fever broth
actions.text: You brew a bitter broth. The steam turns green.

actions.label: Give Ren the broth
actions.text: You give Ren the broth. His breath lengthens.

actions.label: Lime the pits
actions.text: You lime the pits. The air hurts less.

actions.label: Ask Joss the rule
actions.text: Joss says brew first. Then the ward can rest.

actions.label: Ask Oat the still
actions.text: Oat says the still needs herb or the written order.

actions.label: Speak the old name
actions.text: You speak the old name. Venn grants you the wall.

actions.label: Copy the bone name
actions.text: You copy the missing name. Venn grants you the wall.

actions.label: File Ren as living
actions.text: You file Ren as living. Venn marks the wall for the living.

actions.label: Restore the name
actions.text: You set the bone name in the niche. The wall holds.

actions.label: Ask Venn the rule
actions.text: Venn says speak or copy. Then set the stolen name back.

actions.label: Ask Ila about tags
actions.text: Ila points at the crypt. The stolen tag lies there.

actions.label: Ask Sarn for ink
actions.text: Sarn says letters can copy a name the mouth cannot hold.

actions.label: Know the soft cut
actions.text: You name the soft seam. Brin lets you cut for the share.

actions.label: Read the share board
actions.text: You read the share board. Brin lets you cut by the list.

actions.label: Cite the restored name
actions.text: You cite the restored name. Brin counts you as kin of the fold.

actions.label: Cut a safe brick
actions.text: You cut a shallow brick. The face holds.

actions.label: Force a deep cut
actions.text: You force a deep cut. Water fills the toe.

actions.label: Set the peat share
actions.text: You set the brick on the board. Willa marks the share even.

actions.label: Bail the ditch
actions.text: You bail the ditch. The cut face shows again.

actions.label: Ask Brin the rule
actions.text: Brin says cut shallow. Then the brick goes on the board.

actions.label: Ask Jase the face
actions.text: Jase says a deep cut drinks the ditch.

actions.label: Ask Willa the count
actions.text: Willa says a brick on the board holds the fold.

actions.label: Know the low sun
actions.text: You name the low sun line. Rook lets you set a shard.

actions.label: Read the sun chart
actions.text: You read the sun chart. Rook lets you set a shard.

actions.label: Trade peat credit for lead
actions.text: You trade peat credit. Rook hands over a strip of lead.

actions.label: Set the lens shard
actions.text: You set the shard in the peg. A line of light marks the channel.

actions.label: Ask Rook the rule
actions.text: Rook says know the sun. Then set the shard in the loft.

actions.label: Ask Nim for a shard
actions.text: Nim points at the bright shard in the pit.

actions.label: Ask Lise the peg
actions.text: Lise says the peg takes one shard and no more.

actions.label: Know the hemp twist
actions.text: You name the right twist. Tess lets you walk a hank.

actions.label: Read the walk mark
actions.text: You read the walk mark. Tess lets you walk a hank.

actions.label: Sight the channel line
actions.text: You sight the channel line on the floor. The walk holds true.

actions.label: Walk the rope taut
actions.text: You walk the hank taut. Tess marks the pegs done.

actions.label: Haul the slack
actions.text: You haul the slack by force. The line jumps and holds.

actions.label: Ask Tess the rule
actions.text: Tess says know the twist. Then walk a hank taut.

actions.label: Ask Bram for a hank
actions.text: Bram points at the dry hank on the beam.

actions.label: Ask Kite the price
actions.text: Kite pays only for a rope that lies taut.

actions.label: Know the brine cut
actions.text: You name the brine cut. Dorr lets you draw and rake.

actions.label: Read the pan list
actions.text: You read the pan list. Dorr lets you draw and rake.

actions.label: Rig the rake line
actions.text: You rig a taut rake line. The beds can be scraped even.

actions.label: Draw the brine
actions.text: You draw brine. Nell nods at the full bucket.

actions.label: Rake a salt cake
actions.text: You rake a white cake. The bed shows clean stone.

actions.label: Weigh the salt cake
actions.text: You weigh the cake. Pim chalks the mark and the rake is done.

actions.label: Ask Dorr the rule
actions.text: Dorr says draw brine. Then rake a cake and weigh it.

actions.label: Ask Nell the well
actions.text: Nell says the well is brine, not drink.

actions.label: Ask Pim the scale
actions.text: Pim says a cake on the scale closes the rake.

actions.label: Know the wet fish
actions.text: You name the wet fish. Hal lets you hang and tend.

actions.label: Read the cure mark
actions.text: You read the cure mark. Hal lets you hang and tend.

actions.label: Salt the racks
actions.text: You salt the racks. The brine sets the cure.

actions.label: Hang the wet fish
actions.text: You hang the wet fish. The racks take the drip.

actions.label: Tend the smoke
actions.text: You tend the smoke. The racks take an even haze.

actions.label: Take down the cure
actions.text: You take down the cure. Wren marks the rack empty.

actions.label: Ask Hal the rule
actions.text: Hal says hang wet fish. Then tend the smoke and take it down.

actions.label: Ask Bea the hearth
actions.text: Bea says even smoke, not a kiln white.

actions.label: Ask Wren the tally
actions.text: Wren pays only when a rack comes down dry.

actions.label: Know the eel run
actions.text: You name the eel run. Cess lets you set and lift.

actions.label: Read the weir right
actions.text: You read the weir right. Cess lets you set and lift.

actions.label: Bait the weir
actions.text: You bait the stakes. Smoke draws the run in.

actions.label: Set the baskets
actions.text: You set the baskets. The stakes hold the mouths.

actions.label: Lift the weir
actions.text: You lift the weir. Eels twist in the wet wicker.

actions.label: Ask Cess the rule
actions.text: Cess says set the baskets. Then lift the catch.

actions.label: Ask Noll the run
actions.text: Noll says the eels hug the posts at the turn.

actions.label: Ask Meg the count
actions.text: Meg counts only a lift that comes in wet.

actions.label: Know the reed mordant
actions.text: You name the reed mordant. Quill lets you charge and dip.

actions.label: Read the vat list
actions.text: You read the vat list. Quill lets you charge and dip.

actions.label: Bind eel skin
actions.text: You bind eel skin. The vat takes a dark bite.

actions.label: Charge the vat
actions.text: You charge the vat. The liquor takes a reed stain.

actions.label: Dip the cloth
actions.text: You dip the cloth. The vat drinks the white.

actions.label: Hang the color
actions.text: You hang the color. Moss marks the loft dry.

actions.label: Ask Quill the rule
actions.text: Quill says charge the vat. Then dip and hang dry.

actions.label: Ask Fen the vat
actions.text: Fen says stir slow. A boil will ruin the cloth.

actions.label: Ask Moss the line
actions.text: Moss pays only when a pole holds dry color.

actions.label: Know the channel cut
actions.text: You name the channel cut. Bex lets you load and pole.

actions.label: Read the toll board
actions.text: You read the toll board. Bex lets you load and pole.

actions.label: Show the dyed fare
actions.text: You show the dyed fare. Bex lets you load and pole.

actions.label: Load the boat
actions.text: You load the boat. Ivo takes the token and the line.

actions.label: Pole the crossing
actions.text: You pole the crossing. The far bank takes the hull.

actions.label: Claim the landing
actions.text: You claim the landing. Ama stamps the fare paid.

actions.label: Ask Bex the rule
actions.text: Bex says pay a token. Then load and pole across.

actions.label: Ask Ivo the line
actions.text: Ivo says a loaded hull is the only crossing.

actions.label: Ask Ama the stamp
actions.text: Ama stamps only a hull that poled from the near bank.

actions.label: Know the wind cut
actions.text: You name the wind cut. Od lets you set and crank.

actions.label: Read the pump mark
actions.text: You read the pump mark. Od lets you set and crank.

actions.label: Brace the sail
actions.text: You brace the sail. The vanes hold to the wind.

actions.label: Set the vanes
actions.text: You set the vanes. The ring takes the wind.

actions.label: Crank the pump
actions.text: You crank the pump. Water climbs the well.

actions.label: Hold the draw
actions.text: You hold the draw. The flats sit dry.

actions.label: Ask Od the rule
actions.text: Od says set the vanes. Then crank and hold the draw.

actions.label: Ask Rusk the pin
actions.text: Rusk says a pin holds the ring true.

actions.label: Ask Hobb the cut
actions.text: Hobb says a firm board keeps the cut dry.

actions.label: Know the spat set
actions.text: You name the spat set. Wex lets you seed and cull.

actions.label: Read the bed list
actions.text: You read the bed list. Wex lets you seed and cull.

actions.label: Work the dry beds
actions.text: You work the dry beds. The stakes sit firm.

actions.label: Seed the beds
actions.text: You seed the beds. The spat takes the mud.

actions.label: Cull the beds
actions.text: You cull the beds. Gell marks the take even.

actions.label: Ask Wex the rule
actions.text: Wex says seed the beds. Then cull the take.

actions.label: Ask Pip the spat
actions.text: Pip says keep the spat wet and cool.

actions.label: Ask Gell the cull
actions.text: Gell pays only for a cull that comes in even.

actions.label: Know the shell count
actions.text: You name the shell count. Voss lets you mark and seal.

actions.label: Read the tally roll
actions.text: You read the tally roll. Voss lets you mark and seal.

actions.label: Lay the oyster lot
actions.text: You lay the oyster lot. The roll takes the credit.

actions.label: Mark the tally
actions.text: You mark the tally. Rhee nods at the even line.

actions.label: Seal the count
actions.text: You seal the count. Orm shuts the vault on the day.

actions.label: Ask Voss the rule
actions.text: Voss says mark the tally. Then seal the day.

actions.label: Ask Rhee the roll
actions.text: Rhee says the roll must close even.

actions.label: Ask Orm the seal
actions.text: Orm seals only a tally that has been marked.

actions.label: Know the ice cut
actions.text: You name the ice cut. Yul lets you pack and bar.

actions.label: Read the cold mark
actions.text: You read the cold mark. Yul lets you pack and bar.

actions.label: Cite the ice right
actions.text: You cite the ice right. Yul lets you pack and bar.

actions.label: Pack the ice
actions.text: You pack the ice. Straw takes the cold.

actions.label: Bar the door
actions.text: You bar the door. The hold keeps the cold.

actions.label: Ask Yul the rule
actions.text: Yul says pack the ice. Then bar the door.

actions.label: Ask Saff the pit
actions.text: Saff says cut only from the hard face.

actions.label: Ask Kest the bar
actions.text: Kest bars only a hold that is packed.

actions.label: Know the drowned mark
actions.text: You name the drowned mark. Luth lets you wash and lay.

actions.label: Read the wreck list
actions.text: You read the wreck list. Luth lets you wash and lay.

actions.label: Keep the drowned cold
actions.text: You keep the drowned cold. The token holds.

actions.label: Wash the token
actions.text: You wash the token. Brine takes the silt.

actions.label: Lay the token
actions.text: You lay the token. Efa marks the wreck rite done.

actions.label: Ask Luth the rule
actions.text: Luth says wash the token. Then lay it on the altar.

actions.label: Ask Kade the silt
actions.text: Kade says the token lies in the silt.

actions.label: Ask Efa the altar
actions.text: Efa lays only a token that has been washed.

actions.label: Know the hive hum
actions.text: You name the hive hum. Sol lets you smoke and set.

actions.label: Read the skep mark
actions.text: You read the skep mark. Sol lets you smoke and set.

actions.label: Bless the skep
actions.text: You bless the skep. The hive takes the drowned ward.

actions.label: Smoke the hive
actions.text: You smoke the hive. The bees drop and still.

actions.label: Set the skep
actions.text: You set the skep. Wick marks the hive kept.

actions.label: Ask Sol the rule
actions.text: Sol says smoke the hive. Then take comb and set.

actions.label: Ask Tansy the smoke
actions.text: Tansy says a light smoke calms the hive.

actions.label: Ask Wick the skep
actions.text: Wick sets only a hive that has been smoked.

actions.label: Know the wild must
actions.text: You name the wild must. Hop lets you mash and tap.

actions.label: Read the cask mark
actions.text: You read the cask mark. Hop lets you mash and tap.

actions.label: Pitch true comb
actions.text: You pitch true comb. The mash takes the hive wax.

actions.label: Mash the must
actions.text: You mash the must. The crock takes the sweet.

actions.label: Tap the cask
actions.text: You tap the cask. Sera marks the mead drawn.

actions.label: Ask Hop the rule
actions.text: Hop says mash the must. Then bung and tap.

actions.label: Ask Mal the mash
actions.text: Mal says mash until the comb breaks.

actions.label: Ask Sera the tap
actions.text: Sera taps only a bunged mash.

actions.label: Know the stave soak
actions.text: You name the stave soak. Jute lets you soak and raise.

actions.label: Read the hoop mark
actions.text: You read the hoop mark. Jute lets you soak and raise.

actions.label: Mark the mead cask
actions.text: You mark the mead cask. The hoop takes the drawn size.

actions.label: Soak the stave
actions.text: You soak the stave. The wood takes the water.

actions.label: Raise the barrel
actions.text: You raise the barrel. Bess marks the hoop set.

actions.label: Ask Jute the rule
actions.text: Jute says soak the stave. Then hoop and raise.

actions.label: Ask Corm the soak
actions.text: Corm says soak until the stave bends.

actions.label: Ask Bess the raise
actions.text: Bess raises only a soaked stave.

actions.label: Know the pickle cut
actions.text: You name the pickle cut. Rill lets you pack and lid.

actions.label: Read the pickle list
actions.text: You read the pickle list. Rill lets you pack and lid.

actions.label: Hoop the pickle
actions.text: You hoop the pickle. The lid takes a raised hoop.

actions.label: Pack the pickle
actions.text: You pack the pickle. The tub takes the cut.

actions.label: Lid the pickle
actions.text: You lid the pickle. Tov marks the cask shut.

actions.label: Ask Rill the rule
actions.text: Rill says pack the pickle. Then brine and lid.

actions.label: Ask Ora the pack
actions.text: Ora says pack until the cut sits under brine.

actions.label: Ask Tov the lid
actions.text: Tov lids only a packed pickle.

jute.idle: He tests a stave and does not speak first.

kest.idle: He keeps one hand on the bar.

kite.idle: He weighs a purse and watches the far pegs.

lise.idle: She holds a sun chart to the hole.

luth.idle: He keeps a wreck list under his arm.

mal.idle: She turns the mash and waits.

meg.idle: She keeps a tally stick by the door.

miller.idle: He keeps a thumb on the debt board.
miller.name: Miller Brann

mira.idle: She coils rope and eyes the first ledge.
mira.name: Mira

moss.idle: She holds a dry line and watches the poles.

nell.idle: She keeps the brine bucket from the well lip.
nell.name: Nell

nia.idle: She keeps a dry roll under her arm.

nim.idle: She sorts shards and keeps her gloves on.

noll.idle: He watches the pool and does not splash.
noll.name: Noll

oat.idle: He tends the still and does not taste the steam.

od.idle: He watches the vanes and does not speak first.
od.name: Od

ora.idle: She turns the pack and waits.
ora.name: Ora

orm.idle: He holds a seal and does not speak first.
orm.name: Orm

pell.idle: She watches the kiln mouth and waits.
pell.name: Pell

pim.idle: He taps the scale and waits for a cake.
pim.name: Pim

pip.idle: She fans the spat trays and waits.
pip.name: Pip

quill.idle: He rubs stain from his wrists and waits.
quill.name: Quill

rell.idle: He watches the dike and the weather.
rell.name: Rell

ren.idle: He lies still and watches the tent peak.
ren.name: Ren

rhee.idle: She taps the quill and waits.
rhee.name: Rhee

rill.idle: He sniffs the brine and does not speak first.
rill.name: Rill

rook.idle: He squints at the empty frame.
rook.name: Rook

rusk.idle: She holds a pin and eyes the loose sails.
rusk.name: Rusk

saff.idle: She tests the ice face with a saw.
saff.name: Saff

sarn.idle: He scrapes a bone strip for ink.
sarn.name: Sarn

sera.idle: He keeps a tap peg and does not look up.
sera.name: Sera

sila.idle: She counts sacks and does not smile.
sila.name: Sila

sol.idle: He listens to the hive and does not speak first.
sol.name: Sol

tam.idle: He looks at the floor and does not speak first.
tam.name: Tam

tansy.idle: She keeps a rag of smoke and waits.
tansy.name: Tansy

tess.idle: She keeps a hook in her belt and waits.
tess.name: Tess

tov.idle: He keeps a lid hoop and does not look up.
tov.name: Tov

venn.idle: He keeps his palm on an empty niche.
venn.name: Keeper Venn

voss.idle: He keeps a thumb on the open roll.
voss.name: Voss

watch_sergeant.idle: She keeps a finger on the ledger.
watch_sergeant.name: Watch sergeant

wex.idle: He keeps a thumb on the bed list.
wex.name: Wex

wick.idle: He mends a straw skep and does not look up.
wick.name: Wick

willa.idle: She counts bricks and does not stack uneven.
willa.name: Willa

wounded_runner.idle: She sits on the shell track and binds a knee.
wounded_runner.name: Wounded runner

wren.idle: She taps a tally stick and eyes the pegs.
wren.name: Wren

yul.idle: He wraps straw around a block and waits.
yul.name: Yul

ashfen.causeway.name: Ashfen Causeway
ashfen.causeway.situation: A raised track of packed shell. The stacks rise inland.

camp.gate.name: Fever Camp Gate
camp.gate.situation: Lime marks a rope line. A lamp burns with a sour wick.

situation_if.text: A clean boat could see the road fire.
The rope line hangs slack.

camp.pits.name: Lime Pits
camp.pits.situation: Open pits hold lime and rags. The air bites the nose.

camp.still.name: Herb Still
camp.still.situation: A clay still ticks. Bitter steam beads on the lid.

camp.ward.name: Sick Ward
camp.ward.situation: Low cots fill the tent. Ren breathes in short hits.

situation_if.text: Ren sleeps cool.

camp.yard.name: Camp Yard
camp.yard.situation: Pallets sit in two rows. Joss keeps the sick from the well.

coop.hoop.name: Hoop Pegs
coop.hoop.situation: Iron hoops sit on a peg. A stave set lies ready.

situation_if.text: True mead would mark this hoop.
The hoop sits still and even.

coop.path.name: Cooper Path
coop.path.situation: A cooper yard sits on the bank. Wet staves lean in a row.

coop.raise.name: Raise Frame
coop.raise.situation: Bess waits by a barrel form. The raise frame is set.

coop.soak.name: Soak Trough
coop.soak.situation: Corm keeps a soak trough. Staves lie in the water.

coop.yard.name: Cooper Yard
coop.yard.situation: Jute waits by a hoop mark. The soak smell is sharp.

count.desk.name: Tally Desk
count.desk.situation: Rhee keeps a dry quill. The tally roll lies blank.

situation_if.text: An oyster lot would close a gap in the roll.
The roll is shut for the day.

count.loft.name: Tally Loft
count.loft.situation: Blank slates lean on a rack. Dust sits on the top edge.

count.path.name: Count Path
count.path.situation: A low stone house sits inland. Chalk dust hangs in the door.

count.vault.name: Count Vault
count.vault.situation: An iron door stands shut. Orm waits with a seal.

situation_if.text: The seal is set and the door is shut.

count.yard.name: Count Yard
count.yard.situation: Voss waits by a slate board. The day's count is still open.

court.archive.name: Reed Archive
court.archive.situation: Shelves of wet-ink rolls. The air smells of reed glue.

court.cell.name: Holding Cell
court.cell.situation: A damp cell. Tam sits on a board and waits.

court.gate.name: Reed Court Gate
court.gate.situation: Reed screens a low stone gate. A bailiff bars the path.

situation_if.text: The gate stands open after the sentence.

court.hall.name: Reed Hall
court.hall.situation: A round hall. The magistrate sits on a reed mat.

situation_if.text: Orin has heard of the mill pact.
The hall is still after the sentence.

court.yard.name: Court Yard
court.yard.situation: Wet flags hold a quiet crowd. Reeds hiss along the wall.

dye.loft.name: Dye Loft
dye.loft.situation: Poles wait for wet cloth. Moss keeps a dry line clear.

dye.path.name: Dye Path
dye.path.situation: Vat steam hangs over a clay track. Stained rags mark the way.

dye.store.name: Cloth Store
dye.store.situation: White cloth sits in a dry chest. The air smells of lye.

dye.vats.name: Dye Vats
dye.vats.situation: Three vats hold still liquor. Fen stirs with a long stick.

situation_if.text: Eel skin would bite the vat dark.
One vat sits spent and cool.

dye.yard.name: Dye Yard
dye.yard.situation: Pots of stain sit by a list. Quill waits with wet hands.

ferry.boat.name: Ferry Boat
ferry.boat.situation: Wet boards lift on the pull. The far bank is a pale line.

situation_if.text: A dyed cloth would pass as fare.
The hull has already made the far bank.

ferry.far.name: Far Landing
ferry.far.situation: Shell and reed mark the far landing. Ama waits with a stamp.

situation_if.text: The stamp is wet on the board.

ferry.path.name: Ferry Path
ferry.path.situation: A wide creek cuts the shell track. A hull waits at a post.

ferry.slip.name: Ferry Slip
ferry.slip.situation: The hull knocks the posts. Ivo holds the line.

ferry.yard.name: Ferry Yard
ferry.yard.situation: A board lists fares. Bex waits with a token box.

fold.cut.name: Peat Cut
fold.cut.situation: A black face of peat. Water seeps at the toe.

situation_if.text: The cut stands in water.

fold.ditch.name: Fold Ditch
fold.ditch.situation: A narrow ditch takes the seepage. Reeds clog the mouth.

fold.green.name: Fold Green
fold.green.situation: A wet common holds a share board. Brin stands by the list.

situation_if.text: Brin has heard a fold name come home.
The share board is marked even.

fold.lane.name: Fold Lane
fold.lane.situation: Black turf banks the track. Smoke from a peat fire hangs low.

fold.shed.name: Share Shed
fold.shed.situation: Dry bricks stack by a chalk board. Willa counts in pairs.

glass.loft.name: Lens Loft
glass.loft.situation: A narrow walk sits behind the frame. A peg waits for a shard.

glass.nave.name: Glass Nave
glass.nave.situation: A round frame holds empty lead. Light falls on the floor.

situation_if.text: The shard throws a line on the stone.

glass.path.name: Lens Path
glass.path.situation: Broken glass winks in the turf. A low ruin shows a round hole.

glass.pit.name: Shard Pit
glass.pit.situation: A pit of broken panes. One shard still takes the light.

glass.yard.name: Glass Yard
glass.yard.situation: Lead strips lie in a crate. The nave wall is open to the sky.

situation_if.text: Rook will take peat credit for lead.

hive.comb.name: Comb House
hive.comb.situation: Open comb drips on a board. The air is sweet.

hive.path.name: Hive Path
hive.path.situation: Skeps sit on a dry bank. Bees hang in a low cloud.

hive.shed.name: Hive Shed
hive.shed.situation: Wick waits with a spare skep. Straw lies in a heap.

hive.skeps.name: Skep Row
hive.skeps.situation: Straw skeps sit in a row. Tansy keeps a rag of smoke.

situation_if.text: A drowned ward would bless the hive.
The row sits still and even.

hive.yard.name: Hive Yard
hive.yard.situation: Sol waits by a hive mark. The hum is even.

ice.door.name: Ice Door
ice.door.situation: A thick door leans on a bar. Kest waits.

ice.hold.name: Ice Hold
ice.hold.situation: Straw and straw line a dark room. The air bites.

situation_if.text: The hold sits packed and still.

ice.path.name: Ice Path
ice.path.situation: A cut in the bank holds shade. Cold air leaks from a door.

ice.pit.name: Ice Pit
ice.pit.situation: Sawdust covers a pit of ice. Saff keeps a saw.

ice.yard.name: Ice Yard
ice.yard.situation: Yul waits by a cold mark. Straw wraps a block of ice.

situation_if.text: A closed tally would buy the ice right.

mead.crock.name: Crock Row
mead.crock.situation: Open crocks sit on a board. A bung lies ready.

mead.mash.name: Mash Tun
mead.mash.situation: Mal keeps a mash paddle. Comb lies in a tub.

situation_if.text: True comb would pitch this mash.
The mash sits still and even.

mead.path.name: Mead Path
mead.path.situation: A mash house sits on the bank. Sweet steam hangs low.

mead.tap.name: Tap Bench
mead.tap.situation: Sera waits by a cask. A tap peg hangs.

mead.yard.name: Mead Yard
mead.yard.situation: Hop waits by a cask mark. The mash smell is sharp.

mill.kiln.name: Kiln
mill.kiln.situation: A brick kiln holds the heat. Ash cakes the damper bar.

situation_if.text: The mouth runs white.
A low fire ticks in the grate.

mill.lane.name: Mill Lane
mill.lane.situation: Clay ruts climb from the shell road. Kiln smoke hangs inland.

mill.loft.name: Grain Loft
mill.loft.situation: Dust hangs between the beams. Rats tick in the sacks.

mill.sluice.name: Mill Sluice
mill.sluice.situation: Dark water turns the wheel. One stone sits off true.

mill.yard.name: Mill Yard
mill.yard.situation: Sacks lean on a debt board. The mill wheel knocks slow.

situation_if.text: The miller names dock rates.
The debt board is blank.
Reed chaff on the sacks smells like home.

name.crypt.name: Name Crypt
name.crypt.situation: A cold shelf. One tag lies in the dust.

name.hall.name: Name Hall
name.hall.situation: A wall of small niches. Most tags are gone.

situation_if.text: Venn has heard a living name from the camp.
One niche holds a bone name again.

name.path.name: Namehouse Path
name.path.situation: A cut of white stone sinks toward a low door. Wind names no one.

name.script.name: Script Room
name.script.situation: A desk of scraped bone. Ink sits in a shell.

name.yard.name: Name Yard
name.yard.situation: Bone tags hang on a dry line. Ila watches the door.

oyster.beds.name: Oyster Beds
oyster.beds.situation: Stakes mark the park. Empty shells click underfoot.

situation_if.text: The dry flats would let you work the beds.
The stakes sit empty and picked.

oyster.path.name: Oyster Path
oyster.path.situation: Shell heaps edge the leat. The beds lie in the wet.

oyster.shed.name: Cull Shed
oyster.shed.situation: A cull board waits. Gell holds a knife and a tally.

oyster.spat.name: Spat House
oyster.spat.situation: Trays of young spat sit in shade. Pip keeps the lid.

oyster.yard.name: Oyster Yard
oyster.yard.situation: Wex waits by a list of beds. Spat dust hangs.

pans.beds.name: Salt Beds
pans.beds.situation: Shallow beds hold brine. A crust forms at the rims.

situation_if.text: A taut line could rake the beds even.
One bed is scraped clean.

pans.path.name: Pans Path
pans.path.situation: White crust edges the track. The pans flash in the flats.

pans.shed.name: Weigh Shed
pans.shed.situation: A beam scale sits on a crate. Pim waits with chalk.

pans.well.name: Brine Well
pans.well.situation: A stone well tastes of salt. Nell keeps the bucket.

pans.yard.name: Pans Yard
pans.yard.situation: Rakes lean on a low wall. Dorr waits by a list of pans.

pickle.lid.name: Lid Bench
pickle.lid.situation: Tov waits by a cask lid. A hoop peg hangs.

situation_if.text: A raised hoop would bind this lid.
The lid sits still and even.

pickle.pack.name: Brine Shelf
pickle.pack.situation: Brine jars sit on a shelf. One jar is full.

pickle.path.name: Pickle Path
pickle.path.situation: A pickle house sits on the bank. Brine steam hangs low.

pickle.tub.name: Pack Tub
pickle.tub.situation: Ora keeps a pack tub. Cut reed sits in brine.

pickle.yard.name: Pickle Yard
pickle.yard.situation: Rill waits by a pickle mark. The brine smell is sharp.

pump.crank.name: Pump Crank
pump.crank.situation: A long crank waits. The well mouth is still.

pump.path.name: Pump Path
pump.path.situation: A ring of sails stands on the leat. The flats shine wet.

pump.sump.name: Pump Sump
pump.sump.situation: Water pools in a clay cut. Hobb waits with a board.

situation_if.text: The cut sits dry and firm.

pump.tower.name: Vane Tower
pump.tower.situation: Loose vanes slap. A pin lies in the dust.

situation_if.text: A hull line would brace the sail.
The ring holds still and true.

pump.yard.name: Pump Yard
pump.yard.situation: Od waits by a mark on the post. The vanes tick above.

road.beacon.name: Road Beacon
road.beacon.situation: A stone post holds a dark pan. The flats wait for a light.

situation_if.text: The pan burns and the road holds.

road.dike.name: Sea Dike
road.dike.situation: A low dike cuts the flats. Water works the far side.

road.drownway.name: Drownway
road.drownway.situation: The old road is a wet cut. Poles vanish in the flats.

road.ford.name: Drowned Ford
road.ford.situation: A shell track sinks into the flats. Poles mark the old road.

road.hut.name: Dike Hut
road.hut.situation: A tarred hut leans on the dike. A lamp sits unlit.

situation_if.text: Cal has heard the reed sentence.

rope.end.name: Walk End
rope.end.situation: The shed opens on a small landing. Kite waits with a purse.

rope.loft.name: Hemp Loft
rope.loft.situation: Dry hanks hang from the beams. Bram sits on a crate.

rope.path.name: Ropewalk Path
rope.path.situation: A long shed shows at the end of a shell track. Hemp dust hangs.

rope.walk.name: The Walk
rope.walk.situation: A long floor runs the shed. Pegs wait for a taut line.

situation_if.text: A line of light from the ruin cuts the floor.
The new rope lies taut on the pegs.

rope.yard.name: Rope Yard
rope.yard.situation: Hooks and hooks of unused strand. Tess waits by the door.

saltfen.dock.name: Saltfen Dock
saltfen.dock.situation: Wet planks shift under the tide. Nets hang from tarred posts.

situation_if.text: The dock crew move with a shared list.
The mud smell feels like home.
Salt and tar sting your city nose.

saltfen.inn.name: Saltfen Inn
saltfen.inn.situation: A cramped room. Stew ticks on a black stove.

saltfen.market.name: Saltfen Market
saltfen.market.situation: Stalls crowd the wet stone. Eel smoke hangs low.

situation_if.text: The eel-seller leaves a space at his board.
A watch pair nod as you pass.

saltfen.salvage.name: Salvage Yard
saltfen.salvage.situation: Heaps of ship iron and rope fill the lot. Each piece has a tag.

saltfen.tidegate.name: Tide Gate
saltfen.tidegate.situation: A stone arch meets the mudflat. Water writes the hour.

saltfen.warehouse.name: Harbor Warehouse
saltfen.warehouse.situation: Dust and salt crust the crates. One chest sits unlatched.

saltfen.watchhouse.name: Watch-house
saltfen.watchhouse.situation: A low stone room. A ledger sits open by the door.

smoke.hearth.name: Smoke Hearth
smoke.hearth.situation: A low hearth feeds the racks. Bea watches the draw.

smoke.loft.name: Cure Loft
smoke.loft.situation: Dry fish hang from pegs. Wren waits with a tally stick.

smoke.path.name: Smoke Path
smoke.path.situation: A shed leaks a thin haze. Fish skins hang on the fence.

smoke.racks.name: Fish Racks
smoke.racks.situation: Poles hold wet fish. Drip ticks on the boards.

situation_if.text: A brine cake would set the cure.
The rack is empty and dry.

smoke.yard.name: Smoke Yard
smoke.yard.situation: Racks stand under a low roof. Hal waits by a cure mark.

stacks.base.name: Stack Base
stacks.base.situation: Broken towers lean over scree. Ropes hang from the first ledge.

situation_if.text: Climbers watch you like a snare.

stacks.midledge.name: Mid Ledge
stacks.midledge.situation: A wide shelf of old floor. Birds nest in the beam holes.

stacks.relic.name: Relic Chamber
stacks.relic.situation: A round room. Ash cakes a stone bowl in the center.

stacks.switchback.name: Switchback
stacks.switchback.situation: A narrow path cuts the outer wall. Wind tugs your shirt.

stacks.undercroft.name: Undercroft
stacks.undercroft.situation: A low vault under the bridge. Beams creak when you touch them.

stacks.windbridge.name: Wind Bridge
stacks.windbridge.situation: Planks span a gap. A guyline hums in the wind.

weir.hut.name: Weir Hut
weir.hut.situation: Dry baskets hang. Meg waits with a count board.

weir.path.name: Weir Path
weir.path.situation: A stake line cuts the creek. Eel slime shines on the posts.

weir.pool.name: Eel Pool
weir.pool.situation: Dark water holds. Noll crouches at the lip.

weir.stakes.name: Weir Stakes
weir.stakes.situation: Baskets sit empty on the posts. The creek pulls past.

situation_if.text: A strip of cure would bait the mouths.
The baskets sit empty and wet.

weir.yard.name: Weir Yard
weir.yard.situation: Wicker mouths lean on a rail. Cess waits by a run mark.

wreck.altar.name: Wreck Altar
wreck.altar.situation: A low altar faces the broken prow. Efa waits.

wreck.hull.name: Wreck Hull
wreck.hull.situation: Dark water sits in the hold. A token lies in the silt.

situation_if.text: Held ice would keep the drowned token cold.
The silt sits empty where the token lay.

wreck.path.name: Wreck Path
wreck.path.situation: Ribs of a wreck rise from the mud. A chapel sits in the hull.

wreck.wash.name: Wreck Wash
wreck.wash.situation: A stone bowl holds brine. The token must be washed.

wreck.yard.name: Wreck Yard
wreck.yard.situation: Luth waits by a wreck list. Salt crusts the door.
